title: Georgian for Garmin font registry
description: Garmin stock font packs that get Georgian glyphs, the font the glyphs come from, and the watch models each pack was verified on.

georgian_font.description: The TrueType font the Georgian glyphs are rendered from, and its license.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file, 64 lowercase hex digits.

part_number.description: A Garmin part number, such as 006-D9035-03.

pack.description: One stock font family in all the sizes Garmin publishes it in.

id.description: Stable identifier: lowercase words joined by hyphens.

name.description: Garmin's product name for the pack, as its update catalog shows it.

weight.description: The weight the pack's stock glyphs are drawn at; Georgian is drawn at it too.

tested.description: Watches on which the Georgian build was installed and rendered Georgian.

part.description: One size of a pack: a stock .fnt file on Garmin's download server.

size_px.description: Nominal pixel size, about the height of the part's capitals. Georgian is sized by measuring the stock glyphs, not by this value.

version.description: Garmin's release version of the file, as in its footer (2.10).

url.description: The official download URL from Garmin's update catalog.

weight.description: The weight this part's stock glyphs are drawn at, where it differs from the pack's.
A Noto Sans Georgian weight, as a value on its wght axis: 400 Regular, 700 Bold.

model.description: Model description as the watch reports it (Venu 2).

model_part.description: The watch's own part number (GarminDevice.xml Model/PartNumber).

software.description: The watch's software version during the test (19.05).

parts.description: Parts of this pack seen rendering Georgian on that watch.
